claim.quote: These data provide the most sensitive direct detection constraints on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering to date, with significant sensitivity at low WIMP masses for spin-independent WIMP-nucleon scattering.

key_value.quote: with a total exposure of 211.5 kg-days

name: Dark Matter Search Results from the PICO-2L C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: The first dark-matter results from a bubble chamber filled with C3F8 refrigerant, deep underground at SNOLAB. The paper claims no dark matter signal and sets the most sensitive limits then on dark matter that couples to the proton's spin.
summary.technical: 2-litre C3F8 chamber, 211.5 kg-days at four recoil-energy thresholds from 3.2 to 8.1 keV; twelve single nuclear-recoil candidates whose timing is not consistent with a uniform distribution, 'no evidence for a dark matter signal is claimed'; excellent electron-recoil and alpha rejection at low threshold (Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 231302).

title: Dark Matter Search Results from the PICO-2L C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract states these are the most sensitive direct-detection constraints to date on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering.
